answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, and as a result paying the echo bond on all of them and exposing each to the bridge slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 16 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the ivory audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. The deposit is 53 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
